notes: No newer public or prerelease FSR SDK was found in the October 1 scan.

optiscaler.nightly_note: Latest scanned master adds DLSS DX11/Vulkan through DX12 interop; CONTROL remains native D3D12, so track this as an integration reference rather than a reason to replace the host.

amdnr.control_resonant_note: 0.3.5 includes the second-swapchain/frame-generation crash fix and Ray Regeneration diagnostics.
amdnr.late_scan_note: AMDNR 0.3.5 remains the core release, but the Oct 2 upstream source uploads materially change integration work: the previously missing AmdBridge/AmdPreSr/SubmissionState/RuntimeHostLoad implementation is now public. Keep the core release pin separate from the moving source snapshot.
amdnr.source_unlock_note: The old missing-source blocker is resolved. Next bounded work is to map the existing CONTROL MV/subrect/history patch onto the now-public AMDNR implementation and validate it without touching the live game install.

daniel_runtime.rdna4_claim: 8% faster in Fast mode and 6% faster in Reference mode on RX 9000/RDNA4.
daniel_runtime.source_tree_note: The v0.5.1 tag points at the same source tree as v0.5.0; the advertised RDNA4 gain is therefore packaged-runtime/build behavior rather than a cherry-pickable source delta.
daniel_runtime.quality_policy: Track Reference as the quality-first baseline; Fast is optional and is not made the CONTROL default.

lmxxf_rdna4.pin_reason: 0.39 remains the tagged package baseline. The CONTROL quality-safe production source pin stays at 0edf4bd until CONTROL visual validation: upstream 8af8624 has now installed the next-candidate after an LLVM23 barrier audit (HIP_BARRIER_FENCE), with 19 regression groups SAME and RE9 smoke/replay checks passing, but that is stronger cross-project evidence rather than direct CONTROL validation.

stable_effect.900_tier_ms: about 8.0 -> 7.6 at the prior 0.38 measured baseline; 0.39 is the current tag and the exact source pin remains separately validated
stable_effect.1080_tier_ms: about 10.8 -> 10.4 at the prior 0.38 measured baseline; 0.39 is the current tag and the exact source pin remains separately validated
stable_effect.default_output: quality-first exact path; no lossy fast tier enabled

do_not_enable_by_default.reason: Intentionally lossy compact 1080 tier; quality-first CONTROL baseline keeps NVIDIA geometry.
QKV_PIPE was bit-exact but null and remains off.
HIP_DEC_NT was bit-exact but not taken.
SP_ENDS was not taken because the current 1080 baseline was slower.
ViT gather fold/C512 dead-store experiment was bit-exact but not taken; macros stay off.
Lossy fast-tier recipe was opt-in only and was later shelved; do not make it a CONTROL default.
Lossy temporal reuse can soften subtle motion; quality-first CONTROL validation keeps it off.

mochizuki_dlssnr_amd.windows_status_at_commit: v0.0.3 ships an experimental Windows preview; RX 9070 XT offline network timings are published, but broad game validation is still limited. The CONTROL-relevant MV/subrect/history semantics remain inherited from v0.0.2.5.
control_relevant_changes: Normalise DLSSNR.MVecScale by the motion texture's own active region rather than colour size.
Use full-resolution game motion vectors in place where the resource supports it instead of a quarter-resolution copy.
Honor non-zero motion-vector and depth subrect bases.
Use sigmoid(network) times model blend_scale 0.7397 for temporal history weight.
mochizuki_dlssnr_amd.port_policy: Adapt semantics to the CONTROL host and validate geometry before changing live rendering; do not blindly copy Linux/Vulkan code into AMDNR.

theautomatic.use: full-source integration reference for AmdBridge/lmxxf lifecycle and backend switching
theautomatic.live_replace_policy: do not replace the live AMDNR host with this package while FSR Ray Regeneration is required
theautomatic.quality_note: 1.9.9.1 fixes resource lifetime/backend-switching and unbounded diagnostic logging, but still uses upstream lmxxf 0.37. Keep adaptive/lossy temporal reuse off for the CONTROL quality baseline.
